about: What is published (public-release O1.2): the hosted graph, plus what it needs to build, test and run.
An allowlist, so it fails safe: a path is published only when an include matches it and no exclude does. A new private note is left out by default.
Patterns are repository paths. `**` matches across directories and `*` within one name.
scripts/check-publish.mjs refuses its own never-list whatever this file says: src/self/, the console and Solana entrypoints, sol/, the Solana scripts, art/, data/ and the private docs.
It also fails when a published file needs one that is not published, so a test that reaches src/self/ has to be excluded here, with its reason.
rename: a listed file published under another name. package: what scripts/export-public.mjs keeps of package.json (O1.4a).

rename.why: This repository's README.md documents the console and the snipers, which are not published, so it is not published either. The public one lives beside it.
This repository's docs/deploy.md also covers the private gateway and links private specs. The public guide is the site's part of it.
This repository commits the SDK bundle, and its .gitignore names the private tools. A clone must ignore the bundle it builds, so that it is never committed to the public repository.

about: The published package.json (O1.4a), written by scripts/export-public.mjs from this repository's. Only what is named here is kept, so a new private script or dependency is left out by default.
scripts: kept in this repository's order, each cut to the && parts whose files are published. The export fails when one is missing, or names only unpublished files.
alias: a published script that runs another's command. `npm start` runs the web app.
fields: copied as they are. Every other field, optionalDependencies (the Solana sniper's) included, is left out.
